product.description: 2.5" HDD/SSD external case that converts an internal 2.5-inch drive into an external USB drive. Tool-free, driverless, plug-and-play design over a USB 2.0 interface. Note: USB 2.0 is the enclosure's maximum interface speed, so even a fast SSD installed inside will be capped by the USB 2.0 connection.

specs.label: Purpose
specs.value: Converts a 2.5-inch internal HDD or SSD into an external USB drive

faqs.question: Will my SSD run at full speed in this case?
faqs.answer: No — this enclosure's interface is USB 2.0, so even a fast SSD will be capped at USB 2.0 speeds. If you need full SSD speed, you'll want a USB 3.0/3.1 enclosure instead.

faqs.question: Does it fit both HDDs and SSDs?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's built for any standard 2.5-inch HDD or SSD.

faqs.question: Do I need any tools or drivers to set it up?
faqs.answer: No — it's tool-free and driverless, just slot the drive in and plug it into a USB port.
